scenes.summary: You learn that Operator Arclight sends out a request for help. You decide to talk to her and ask about the situation.

lines.text: She taught many about the techniques of survival.
But now a Songseeker is asking us for help. That means she's probably facing some serious trouble.
We better not delay, then. Let's hurry and ask her about the situation.
Endmin, I believe Fiona has filled you in on the situation? Operator ⟦key|Arclight⟧ was the one who requested support.

The Hannabit Circuit. They're a partner of Endfield Industries. Simply put, the Circuit is a group of wildland roamers who are happy to share the wisdom of survival. Many refer to their tribes as the "academy of the wilderness".
Operator Arclight happens to be their Songseeker. They travel around and lend their aid to those in need.

Songseekers acquire plenty of experience as they travel and endure the wilderness. They would teach these lessons in the form of hanna songs to anyone who needs them. Naturally, this also includes Endfielders.

options: Didn't she live in a tribe or something?
She's a Songseeker of some Circuit, right?

r: Didn't she live in a tribe or something?
She's a Songseeker of some Circuit, right?

scenes.summary: You expect to meet with Arclight but Karja shows up instead. Turns out that Mia of the refugee camp has gone missing and he asked Arclight to call Endfield for help. Arclight has already started the search by tracking down Landbreaker graffiti that Mia drew over. You decide to follow the same clues.

lines.text: Someone's waiting for us by the entrance! Hmm? Wait, Perlica... That doesn't look like Arclight.
Over here! Oh thank goodness, you've arrived so quickly.
I haven't seen you for a while, Karja. Why are you the one meeting up with us? Where's Arclight?
Arclight went out looking for the child ... right after she left you the message.
Thank you so much! I know the others won't let me go 'cos they think I'll just end up causing more trouble... Please help us find Mia!
Hmm. Arclight ventured out into the wilderness on her own at a time like this. She must be really skilled!
She asked me to stay here so I can tell you about the situation.
A child went missing? At noon? We gotta start looking for her! Do you have any clues?
She's a friend of Ginny's, and her name's Mia. Her brother has patrol duty today, and asked me to look after her.
Mia's an energetic girl. She really likes to run around the camp. I told her that this area isn't very safe.
Oh yeah, we got some drawings up ahead. Mia made them by painting over the Landbreaker graffiti.
Perhaps the drawings have meaning! Maybe Mia is trying to tell us something with them!
Endmin, let's follow this trail of clues.
A child went missing from our camp! She disappeared around noon today!
But I was tasked with something else this morning and took my eyes off her for just a brief moment... By the time I went to get her for lunch, she was already gone.
Arclight found them and told me she could use them as clues. So she left to follow Mia's drawings. The mere mentioning of Landbreakers gives me the shakes... I'm worried that...

options: Let's go. Hope we can be fast enough.
Take care of yourself, Karja. Stay out of trouble.

r: Let's go. Hope we can be fast enough.
Take care of yourself, Karja. Stay out of trouble.

scenes.summary: You find Mia's brush at the last graffiti as well as signs of fighting. A Bonekrushers "lab" is up ahead. You decide to proceed carefully.

lines.text: Looks like there was a fight here... Hey, that might be Mia's brush! Oh no, this doesn't look good...
Be cautious. The surrounding areas used to be Bonekrusher territory that we cleared out before.
Roger. Let's go!
Wait. This looks like ... the Endmin's mask!
Mia is a friend of Ginny. Perhaps Ginny told her about the Endmin.
But this glyph is a symbol of "territory" ... and that worries me. It means some of the Bonekrushers have returned.

options: This is the last of the graffiti. Where's Arclight?

r: This is the last of the graffiti. Where's Arclight?

lines.text: Among manglerbeasts battling for ground, such cruelty is rare! Why have you wrought this?
That voice...! It's Arclight! We must help her!

scenes.summary: You meet Arclight. She has found a secret door in the rock wall. Perlica suggests performing a scan to reveal the door opening mechanism.

lines.text: Indeed. Karja told us about the situation. What happened here?
I'm not sure. I came across a group of fleeing Landbreakers when I arrived at this place. I knocked down a few of them, and then ran into this mob right here.
Oh ho! You really know a lot about secret doors and mechanisms.
Endmin, let's scan this place and look for mechanisms that might open the secret door.
Apologies, Supervisor Perlica... I failed to rendezvous with you at the appointed location. The situation is worse than I expected. Like a storm, they tear through this place.
The Bonekrushers have marked this place as their territory. These Landbreakers are probably their sentries. We must hurry. More breakers are probably on the way.
This cave... Its echoes do not sound right. The space is narrower than I expected... Yes, a secret door there.
Yeah. I've seen similar designs in a number of ruins.

scenes.summary: Arclight's Originium Arts fail to work on the mechanism. You suspect the problem lies in the Originium circuitry, so you attempt to use your powers to repair the door switch.

lines.text: I'll activate it.
...Strange. I've opened plenty of doors like this. A current of this intensity should have worked.
Could be. Endmin, this should be right up your alley.
I have always wanted to witness your Originium Arts.
Hmm. Okay.
This mechanism is not responding despite me coursing a high current through it. Necessary might be your Arts, Endmin.

options: There's a mechanism here. It's connected to the door.
The problem might lie in the Originium circuitry.

r: There's a mechanism here. It's connected to the door.
The problem might lie in the Originium circuitry.
